newsitem.title: ITALY: Employment in big Italy firms falls yr-yr in June.
newsitem.headline: Employment in big Italy firms falls yr-yr in June.

text.p: Employment in Italian industrial firms with more than 500 employees fell 2.0 percent year-on-year in June, the national statistics institute Istat said on Tuesday.
Its employment index for the sector stood at 76.6 (1988=100) in June, with month-on-month employment down 0.1 percent.
Hours worked per employee fell 5.8 percent year-on-year, which Istat said reflected two fewer working days in the month than in June 1995.
The number of people put on temporary lay-off schemes fell 19.8 percent year-on-year.
In the services sector, the employment index stood at 91.2 (1992=100), a fall of 1.2 percent year-on-year and a rise of 0.3 percent compared with May.
